sources.title: GitHub - waqqasansari/qwen3-grpo-finetune
sources.snippet: This repository contains a Jupyter Notebook for fine-tuning the Qwen3-4B language model using the Unsloth library, with the application of a reward-optimization method called GRPO (Guided Reward-based Prompt Optimization). This training setup is optimized for running in Google Colab or locally on 4-bit/16-bit precision hardware.
